title: Missing test/runtime deps: networkx + vaderSentiment cause 11 pytest failures
description: 11 pre-existing pytest failures across test_internal_linking.py (4 — missing networkx) and test_local_seo.py (7 — missing vaderSentiment). Analyzers use try/except-import and silently degrade to empty/zero when missing. Prod data-integrity implication: if build_audit.py runs in a venv missing these libs, extended internal-link metrics (density, betweenness, communities) and review sentiment are silently zero. Reports/XLSX/PPTX consumers see blank cells. Action: confirm prod venv has these (pip show networkx vaderSentiment in prod). If yes, add to pyproject.toml as optional extras + CI-only. If no, silent prod regression — add to main dependencies. Source: HANDOFF-POST-TIER-3 Section 5b.

title: Investigate v4 branch artifacts (phantom gitlink discovered during Tier 4)
description: During Tier 4 C2 execution, clients/chris-nevada was found registered as a 160000 gitlink pointing at commit 8832cc2c18149536872e8dbdade48026277b34fc — which does NOT exist in the local git db. No .gitmodules ever existed. Introduced by commit a139db9 ('feat: v4 — multi-LLM collab audit, retry logic, contentQuality permanent fix') on the v4 branch (visible at remotes/origin/v4). Cleaned up via Tier 4 C2-prep commit (34f0801). Action needed: investigate v4 branch for other abandoned submodule-style references or experimental artifacts before any future v4 merge or rebase. Bundle with whoever next touches the v4 branch.

title: Reliability sweep: 9 Python connectors bypass _request_sync retry coverage
description: Tier 2 Fix 6 added retry coverage to base._request_sync and routed DataForSEO _post through it. The other 9 sync connectors still call self.sync_client.request()/.post() directly with inline raise_for_status() — no retry coverage for transient failures. Files: connectors/{pagespeed,crux,business_profile,brand_mentions,social_audit,search_console,ga4,google_ads,local_seo}.py. pagespeed.py also has no rate-limit at all. Most natural fit: bundle opportunistically with whatever future fix touches any of these connectors. Source: HANDOFF-POST-TIER-3 Section 5a.

title: Calgary extract-text.js upstream-then-replace
description: Calgary's scripts/extract-text.js is a 275-line fork preserved through Tier 4 sync via sha256-fingerprint guard. Contains Calgary-specific community slugs + richer syllable algorithm + main/article extraction (vs template's body-wide approach). Owner needed: extract universally-useful improvements (syllable algo, main/article extraction) into template; remove Calgary-specific slugs from the fork (or move them to a config-driven mechanism); then sync calgary's extract-text.js. Bundle with whoever next touches extract-text.js or with Tier 5 Fix 16 if it touches the JS gather stack. Source: TIER-4-PLAN Q1.5 + Section 5 NEW item.
